name: ntr_db_get_all_child_master_partcipant_id
xsql:
select pa.participant_id from ShowIncentHierarchy(EffectiveAsOf= :v_qtr_start_date, ParentId = '79167020263211') hier 
inner join xactly.xc_participant pa 
on pa.employee_id = hier.person_latest_employee_id
inner join xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
on pta.position_id = hier.position_id
inner join $framework.NATERA_TITLE_CATEGORY_MAPPING t
on t.title = pta.title_name
where pa.is_master = 1
